_: THE ELEVEN SHIPBUILDING LINES — a country's way of building ships (docs/SHIPS_AND_SKILLS.md §3.1), and the line, size, role and tech of every hull.
_why: Authored here and guarded (scripts/db/world-guard.mjs compares public.ship_lines and public.class_profile with this file on every apply), for the reason data/hulls.json is: a table that lives only inside a migration is the drift the guard exists to kill. First shipped by migration 0130.
_builders: builderNations are the nations whose build yards may build the line's hulls (cmd.do_build, through public.yard_wrong_country). homeNation is the flag the hull is shown under. Every code is a public.nations code.
_arsenal: arsenalPort is the line's chief yard, raised to build-yard tier 3 so every line can build every size (docs/SHIPS_AND_SKILLS.md §3.2: the Atarazanas of Seville, the Amsterdam admiralty yard, the Tersane-i Amire, Surat, Guangzhou, Osaka, Busan). null where the line already has a tier-3 yard. public.harbour_buildings reads it.
_modifiers: mult multiplies the PRT archetype (hold, speed, crew, hull, attack); add is added (handling, armour, accuracy, reach, sighting, draft). Traits are the bonus per level of the line's hull skill. Not read by any rule yet: the generator (S12) and skills (S11) will.

lines.name: Portugal
lines.philosophy: The ocean pioneers: balanced, far-seeing, the anchor of the scale.

lines.name: Spain
lines.philosophy: The treasure fleets: high-sided, armoured, heavily manned, slow.

lines.name: The Netherlands
lines.philosophy: The efficient carriers: huge holds, tiny crews, shallow draft, light guns.

lines.name: England
lines.philosophy: Race-built gun ships: fast, handy, shoot straight and far.

lines.name: France
lines.philosophy: Elegant hulls: quick and handy, all-round.

lines.name: Italy
lines.philosophy: Galleys and great galleys: oared, nimble, crowded, short-ranged.

lines.name: The Ottoman Empire
lines.philosophy: The Arsenal's fleets: stout, manned for boarding.

lines.name: Arabia & India
lines.philosophy: Sewn and teak hulls of the monsoon: fast, sweet-handling, lightly armed.

lines.name: China
lines.philosophy: Bulkheaded junks: roomy, very hard to sink, clumsy.

lines.name: Japan
lines.philosophy: Pine-hulled war boats and red-seal traders: precise gunnery, short range.

lines.name: Joseon
lines.philosophy: Plated decks: the best armour afloat.

_profiles: One row per ship class (public.class_profile). size 1-6 (small, light, medium, heavy, capital, flagship); ship_classes.tier = least(size, 5), so its 1-5 check never moves. anyYard: the hull may be built at every build yard whatever its country — true only for the three hulls every company could already build before 0130.
